text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Twin Turbo's gaze, I saw a crane game
filled with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"—I just had a great idea!
I'm gonna make a video with this plushie!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna get it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gaaah!! Why can't I get it?!
choice_data_list: I'll give it a shot, too...!
I'll give it a shot, too...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!?
Then you'll have to take on Turbo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
